name: Software Support and Maintenance Agreement
description: A standalone agreement under which a software vendor supports and maintains software the customer has already licensed. The checks read for support hours, response and resolution times by severity, updates and new releases, which versions are supported, the fee and how it can rise, and what support does not cover. Distinct from `software-license-enterprise`, which reads a license and its support together.
compliance_matrix_columns: Support hours and how to reach support
Response and resolution times by severity
Which versions are supported, and for how long
The support fee, and how it can rise
